rules.description: Complete replacement rule list; [] clears all rules.

items.description: One redirect rule.

domain.description: Custom domain name; null requests provider-default domain.

ogImage.description: Open Graph image URL; null clears it.

ogTitle.description: Open Graph title; null clears it.

bodyTags.description: Custom body HTML as text; null clears it.

ga4TagId.description: Google Analytics 4 ID; null clears it.

headTags.description: Custom head HTML as text; null clears it.

qrStyles.description: Complete QR styling dictionary replacing the old value; null clears it.

expiresAt.description: Expiry instant with explicit offset and year 2000–2100; null clears it. Fractions are preserved or rejected, not rounded.

privacyMode.description: Paid-plan personal-data suppression; true clears incompatible tracking and notifications.

expiryClicks.description: Click expiry threshold; null clears it.

linkifyWords.description: Provider linkification expression; null clears it.

replacements.description: Provider replacement expression; null clears it.

ogDescription.description: Open Graph description; null clears it.

stickyRotator.description: Set 30-day repeat-visitor destination stickiness; cannot be true in privacy mode.

tiktokPixelId.description: TikTok pixel ID; null clears it.

facebookPixelId.description: Facebook pixel ID; null clears it.

expiryDestination.description: Post-expiry HTTP(S) destination; null clears it.

changes.description: Partial modification: omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears nullable fields; arrays replace their entire current value.

FunctionInput_linkly_updatelink.description: Identify an existing workspace link and supply only settings to change.

url.description: Stored destination URL after the change.

shortUrl.description: Stored complete short URL after the change.

FunctionOutput_linkly_updatelink.description: The updated link and its stored destination and short URL.

tags.instructions: Get a link ID with `list-links` or inspect it with `get-link`. Supply only fields to change. Use `create-link` for a new link. Enabling privacy mode clears incompatible tracking, custom scripts, conversion tracking and notifications, and switches off sticky rotation; turning it off does not recreate those settings.
